headline: SACE and Simest, the export collaboration delivers positive results
summary: The collaboration between SACE and SIMEST to support the internationalization of Italian businesses produced positive results in the first half of 2026. No figures were given in the summary.
why: SACE is Italy's state-owned export credit agency, and SIMEST supports Italian companies expanding abroad. Their activity affects export financing available to Italian firms.
